struct Modular {
    static const int MOD = 1000000007;
    long long val;
    Modular(long long v=0): val(v%MOD) {}
    Modular operator+(const Modular& other) const { return Modular(val + other.val); }
    Modular operator+=(const Modular& other) { val = (val + other.val) % MOD; return *this; }
    Modular operator*(const Modular& other) const { return Modular(val * other.val); }
    Modular operator*=(const Modular& other) { val = (val * other.val) % MOD; return *this; }
    operator int() const { return (int)val; }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n; cin >> n;
    vector<Modular> prob(n * n);
    for (auto& v : prob) {
        int p; cin >> p;
        v = Modular(1) / 100 * p;
    }

    vector<Modular> total;
    int mid = n / 2;
    array<int, 64> maskVal;
    int countMasks = 0;
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 6); ++mask) {
        maskVal[mask] = (__builtin_popcount(mask) == mid) ? countMasks++ : -1;
    }
    total.resize(1 << countMasks);

    auto process = [&](int left, int right, auto handle) {
        int len = right - left;
        for (int edgeMask = 0; edgeMask < (1 << (len * n)); ++edgeMask) {
            Modular totalProb = 1;
            for (int tmp = edgeMask, i = left * n; i < right * n; ++i, tmp >>= 1) {
                totalProb *= (tmp & 1) ? prob[i] : Modular(1) - prob[i];
                if (totalProb.val == 0) goto skip;
            }
            array<char, 6> data{};
            static_assert(6 >= len);
            int matchSets = 0;
            while (true) {
                int matchMask = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
                    if (!((edgeMask >> (i * n + data[i])) & 1)) goto outerSkip;
                    if (matchMask & (1 << data[i])) goto outerSkip;
                    matchMask |= 1 << data[i];
                }
                if (right == n) matchMask ^= (1 << n) - 1;
                matchSets |= 1 << maskVal[matchMask];
            outerSkip:
                int i = len - 1;
                while (i >= 0) {
                    if (data[i] == n - 1) { data[i] = 0; --i; }
                    else { ++data[i]; break; }
                }
                if (i < 0) break;
            }
            handle(matchSets, totalProb);
        skip:;
        }
    };

    process(0, mid, [&](int sets, Modular probSum) {
        total[sets] += probSum;
    });
    for (int d = 1; d < (int)total.size(); d <<= 1)
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)total.size(); ++i)
            if (!(i & d))

    process(mid, n, [&](int sets, Modular probSum) {
